data.headline: Raise price 8% now to lift margin and cover rising timber cost
data.why: The plan lifts unit margin and the simulation shows a positive net profit shift versus holding price. Ikea's push into secondhand furniture signals retail pressure on new premium sets, so a stronger margin now protects cash if volumes soften. The figures above confirm the payback is immediate.
data.watch_out: Volume could drop more than modeled if German retailers cut orders amid the kitchen-furniture crisis. A sharper sales decline would erase the margin gain and leave you with excess stock and tighter cash.
data.recheck_when: Recheck at next quarterly German furniture sales report or if Ikea expands its buy-back program.
